cases.title: Opening, a review due: offered as a quick review (an offer, hands-on), not started

rubric.reason: The mentor offers rather than starts: "It's been about a month since you learned *Pick the key type on purpose*. Want a quick hands-on review on Cut, with no demo this time?" The skill is learned, Cut is in focus_layers, and nothing says the review is owed or overdue.

Two sentences make one suggestion by name, give a plain reason ("been about a month since you learned"), and end on the offer, with no menu, no record recital, no tool or field talk, and no lesson started.
"Pick the key type on purpose" and "Cut" match recommend_next's skill_name and focus_layers, and "about a month" follows from the record's 2026-10-19 last_practiced date.
